top_signals.title: How China Is Setting the Pace on Nuclear Power
top_signals.summary: Sama Bilbao y Leon, Director General of the World Nuclear Association, says China’s 59 reactors under construction demonstrate a programmatic approach to nuclear development that Western Europe and North America should look to replicate. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
